mandate: C336 — test the cross-sectional intraday ORDER-FLOW PERSISTENCE / IMBALANCE AUTOCORRELATION SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1728 pre-registered configs). Per-bar persistence: sign_imbalance=trade_sign_sum/trade_count, signed_vol_share=signed_volume/total_volume, notional_imb=signed_volume/notional, imb_ewm=EWMA(sign_imbalance,halflife=24 bars), imb_ac1=rolling lag-1 autocorr of sign_imbalance over 288 bars, streak_len=run-length of consecutive same-sign trade_sign_sum; per (weekday,tod) bucket over trailing seasonal baseline at same bucket: score=-(v - expanding mean of prev v). Signals: sign_imbalance_dev, signed_vol_share_dev, notional_imb_dev, imb_ewm_dev, imb_ac1_dev, streak_len_dev. Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and persistence-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: trade_count<=0 -> sign_imbalance/streak_len NaN; total_volume<=0 -> signed_vol_share NaN; notional<=0 -> notional_imb NaN; imb_ewm NaN until >= 24 finite obs (no ffill/impute); imb_ac1 NaN unless full 288-bar window finite and nonzero variance; same-bucket seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0; raw flow fields carry zero NaN.

data_quality.note: persistence score NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~MIN_PREV_BASELINE same-bucket occurrences per bucket) plus zero-activity denominators and full-window AC1 exclusions; zero-activity bars add negligible mass.

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; trade_sign_sum/trade_count/signed_volume/total_volume/notional real from C312.
methodology.signals: per (weekday,tod) bucket over trailing seasonal baseline: sign_imbalance=trade_sign_sum/trade_count, signed_vol_share=signed_volume/total_volume, notional_imb=signed_volume/notional, imb_ewm=EWMA(sign_imbalance,24 bars), imb_ac1=rolling lag-1 autocorr of sign_imbalance over 288 bars, streak_len=run-length of consecutive same-sign trade_sign_sum; score=-(v-expanding mean of prev v at same bucket); causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1728 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs imb_persistence_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
